（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

October 20th 191_

Sir,
At 10 a.m. on the 19th inst about 200 rebel natives
of Kiangsu hold a meeting at 335 Sion Tun Li 修德里 Frenchtown.
After much discussion they decided to petition the
repatriation authorities to pay out the funds individually
instead of handing the money to the leaders.
A new office has been opened by the amalgamated
rebels of all provinces at No.71 Pai Kong Lee 宝康里 Avenue
Joffre.
The Chinese Chamber of Commerce has requested that
the distribution of repatriation funds be postponed but
the request has been rejected by the Authorities concerned.
The amalgamated rebels have also decided to send eight
representatives to interview General Yang and ask for the
postponement of the distribution of the funds.
Two regiments of the 10th Division now stationed at
Loongwha who have received instructions to hold themselves
in readiness for a transfer to some other place.
All official yamens in the City and suburbs were
decorated on the 19th inst in recognition of the birthday
of the President.

Your Obedient Servant,

[Signature]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

I. D.

10月23日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

191_年10月20日

先生：

本月19日上午10时，约200名江苏籍叛乱分子在法租界修德里335号举行集会。
经长时间讨论后，他们决定向遣返当局请愿，要求将款项直接发放给个人，而非交给首领。
各省叛乱分子联合组织已在霞飞路宝康里71号开设新办事处。
上海总商会曾请求推迟发放遣返经费，但该请求已被有关当局驳回。
联合叛乱分子还决定派遣八名代表去会见杨将军，要求推迟发放款项。
现驻龙华的第十师两个团已接到命令，随时准备调往他处。
为庆祝总统诞辰，城内及郊区的所有官署均于本月19日张灯结彩以示庆贺。

您顺从的仆人，

[签名]
首席侦探督察长。

警务处总监上尉。
